races.title: Josie Rowe Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: EVERYONESGAME had the form of his reappearance second at Plumpton well and truly boosted when the winner that day finished runner up in a big field handicap at Cheltenham recently and, entitled to come forward from that (won second start after a break last winter) he could well be ready to repeat the feat. Paddy de Pole comes here firmly at the top of his game and may emerge next best, though Docpickedme 's fine record on Town Moor means he can't be discounted either. EVERYONESGAME (IRE) PADDY DE POLE (IRE) DOCPICKEDME (IRE)

races.title: Howcroft Group Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DOWN TO BUSINESS has to concede weight all round back in novice company but he lines up having looked an unlucky loser in a Wetherby handicap 2 weeks ago and may well be up to the task given that was his best effort yet. Dancing Soldier is an interesting hurdles newcomer, whilst One Knight remains with definite potential in this sphere judged on his useful bumper form. DOWN TO BUSINESS DANCING SOLDIER (IRE) ONE KNIGHT (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: One Knight (7/4), Down To Business (5/2), Dancing Soldier (3/1), Arm's Of An Angel (5/1), Pfingstberg (40/1), Northerly (125/1)

races.title: Winter Family Raceday 29th December Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A small field but it looks competitive with 3 progressive last-time-out winners, NAZARE shading the vote over Fairlawn Skipper and Palamon . NAZARE (FR) FAIRLAWN SKIPPER PALAMON (IRE)

races.title: Dranfields CIU National Charity Raceday Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This could be an interesting tussle between QUEEN ALICE and Briery Rose . The former showed plenty in a notable Fairyhouse bumper and may make a successful hurdling/stable debut in receipt of 6 lbs. QUEEN ALICE BRIERY ROSE LADY LITIGATOR (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Queen Alice (6/5), Briery Rose (3/1), Lady Litigator (10/3), Harzandacassandra (10/1), La Trinite (10/1), Aunt Gallie (125/1), Just Rizzo (250/1)

races.title: Apres Village Friday 18th December Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: There's more to come from LIBERTY COACH over hurdles and he's fancied to double up. Rewired is feared as the main danger, especially if supported, with Dan Skelton's Leaumec de Mee potentially anchored by an 11 lb rise. LIBERTY COACH REWIRED LEAUMEC DE MEE (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Leaumec De Mee (15/8), Liberty Coach (2/1), Flash Man (11/4), Cotton Socks (13/2), Itsinthename (25/1), Belfrina (40/1), Rewired (50/1)

races.title: Doncaster 2027 Annual Membership Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: COPSHILL LAD underperformed at Ffos Las when last seen in May but he has a notably good record fresh, which makes him an appealing proposition. Camarrate has run well on all 3 of his chase starts and seems likely to give another good account, while Mumford's Magic is also respected back down in grade. COPSHILL LAD (IRE) CAMARRATE (IRE) MUMFORD'S MAGIC (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Mumford's Magic (11/8), Camarrate (2/1), Copshill Lad (4/1), Getaway Vic (8/1), Breezethroughlife (33/1), I Am The Moon (33/1)

races.title: Grace And Dotty Fillies' 'Junior' NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: IGNITE THE NIGHT shaped encouragingly from the back of the field in a slowly-run race when a place behind Lady Loki on her debut at Stratford last month, so there's plenty of reason to believe she can reverse the form with that rival and come out on top. Sarah's Surprise makes most appeal of the newcomers before market clues. IGNITE THE NIGHT LADY LOKI SARAH'S SURPRISE
